newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Libya says Zaire's Mobutu calls Gaddafi.
newsitem.headline: Libya says Zaire's Mobutu calls Gaddafi.

text.p: Zaire President Mobutu Sese Seko, whose army has lost his country's third largest city to rebels, telephoned Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi, the official Libyan news agency JANA reported.
JANA, monitored in Tunis on Sunday night, said Mobutu briefed Gaddafi on the "evolution of the fighting in the Great Lakes region." The agency did not say when he called.
Mobutu was admitted to a hospital in Monte Carlo on Sunday for further cancer treatment.

Gaddafi last December vowed to support Mobutu, saying he was the sole garantee for Zaire's unity. Official Radio Zaire in January said Libya had agreed to help a planned counter-offensive against rebels.
Tutsi rebels led by Laurent Kabila captured the strategic city of Kisangani on the Zaire river on Saturday.
